Class HybridServerNetworkAdapter

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.network.HybridServerNetworkAdapter
All Implemented Interfaces:
ServerNetworkAdapter, ServerNotifier, LobbyReadyListener
public class HybridServerNetworkAdapter extends Object implements ServerNetworkAdapter, LobbyReadyListener
Hybrid server adapter that runs both Socket and RMI servers in parallel and routes outbound notifications to the correct protocol based on the player.
